name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A Climb and Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and +5 to Athletics checks to climb or swim.
text: While wearing these gloves, you have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and you gain a +5 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb or swim.
